verdicts.reason: A is unusable. The candles shrank to a speck that collides with tiny, illegible address text. The empty frame floats alone on the right, the date is stranded in the top-left corner, and the right half is dead space. B keeps the candles, the frame and readable text in a left-to-right banner, but it is still broken. The 'JOIN US' text overruns the frame line and sits on its gap. The address block hangs off the frame edge. Content is jammed against the left canvas edge, and the frame is no longer a border around the whole design.
